title: Zesty Crunchy Turkish Swede Adana Kebap
description: A peppery and indulgent Turkish dish featuring swede, marinated in a FODMAP-friendly blend, formed into Adana kebap style.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 200 degrees Celsius.
In a large bowl, combine lamb mince, red pepper flakes, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and mix well.
Add grated swede to the bowl and mix until just combined.
Stir in garlic-infused oil, parsley, and lemon juice.
Using your hands, shape the mixture into long thin kebap shapes.
Place the kebaps on a baking tray lined with parchment paper.
Bake the kebaps in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until cooked through.
Increase the oven temperature to 220 degrees Celsius and bake for an additional 5 minutes, or until the kebaps are crispy on the outside.
Remove the kebaps from the oven and let them rest for a few minutes before serving.
